title: Monitor board reads OK for a series whose exporter went silent
summary: The monitor status board on-call watches during an incident reports OK for a series that sent no samples all window, so a blind monitor is indistinguishable from a healthy one and on-call stopped trusting the board.
task: Report each monitored series' status for the fixed evaluation window from the collector feed, so on-call can trust the board during an incident.

company.notes: Observability-shaped monitor evaluation over a fixed window; a mishandled empty-series case defaults the average instead of reporting NO DATA, no syntax fault.

expected_output:
=== Monitor status ===
cache.evictions: OK
db.connections: ALERT
web.error_rate: NO DATA
web.latency_ms: OK
buggy_output:
=== Monitor status ===
cache.evictions: OK
db.connections: ALERT
web.error_rate: OK
web.latency_ms: OK

phase2.spec_patch: Ops now wants a WARN status band. Each monitor line already carries a warning threshold; when a series' window average is at or above its warning threshold but below its critical threshold, report WARN instead of OK. NO DATA and ALERT stay as they are.
phase2.expected_output_v2:
=== Monitor status ===
cache.evictions: OK
db.connections: ALERT
web.error_rate: NO DATA
web.latency_ms: WARN
